author: FilmCow
description:
Welcome to the valley. Relax, take off all your shoes, and enjoy some soothing video games. Check the description below for more info.

I stream daily from 11 p.m. to 1 a.m. Eastern Time.

Current game schedule:
Mon - Alice in Wonderland (CD-I)
Tue - Iron Soldier (Atari Jaguar)
Wed - TBD
Thu - Queen's Quest 4: Sacred Truce (PS4)
Fri - Dark Souls II (Xbox 360)
Sat - Assorted Sega Saturn games
Sun - Assorted PC / Mac games

Chat rules:
* No harassment.
* No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, fatphobia, or other such things.
* No overtly sexual comments.
* No self-promotion unless given permission.
* No spamming (this includes asking the same question over and over.)
* No backseat gaming if the "No Backseat Gaming" cloud is displayed on the TV (unless help is asked for!) This includes mentioning game spoilers, even minor ones.
* No gimmick accounts.

Is it your birthday? We have a machine for that. Please read the following if you'd like to enter your name into the Birthda
title: Dark Souls II (Xbox 360) | The Video Game Valley

author: FilmCow
description:
The night is wet but the paper is dry. Let's write some letters.

Want a letter? Send your NAME and COMPLETE ADDRESS to:
RainCityLetters@gmail.com

Viewer letters are sent out once per stream, completely randomly, from the pool of submissions. I will mail them anywhere in the world, but note that if you're outside the U.S. your "complete address" must include your country.

Chat rules:
* No harassment.
* No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, fatphobia, or other such things.
* No complaining about how late I’m streaming.
* No self-promotion unless given permission.
* No spamming (this includes asking the same question over and over.)
* No gimmick accounts.

You can write to FilmCow at:

FilmCow
PO Box 781790
Orlando, FL 32878
title: Oops! All Viewer Letters
